texto: Put the phrase in normal form and add **のに**: **やくそく した のに、 ともだち は きませんでした** (although we had stayed, my friend did not come).
What goes after **のに** is what is not fulfilled or surprised.
With the **ない** form it also goes the same: **おかね が ない のに、 ふく を かいました** (although I had no money, I bought clothes). With adjectives in -i the normal form is used: **たかい のに、 かいました**.
With nouns and adjectives in -na, adds **な**: **やすみ なのに、 しごと が あります** (although it is a day off, there is work).
